quests.title: Shadow of Mount Wyrmfang
quests.description: Tremors shake the northern holds and blue fire flickers atop Mount Wyrmfang. Jarl Sigurd fears the ancient Frost Wyrm Vyr stirs in its volcanic tomb.

stage_speak_jarl.description: Audience with Jarl Sigurd in the High Mead-Hall of Valenfrost to discuss the mountain portents.

stage_recover_keys.description: Recover the three ancient Star-Keys of High King Valen to secure or shatter the binding seal atop Mount Wyrmfang.
stage_recover_keys.objective: Gather the three Star-Keys (Alpha from Grimstone, Beta from Frostmere, Gamma from the Barrow).

stage_confront_vyr.description: Ascend to the Caldera of Vyr atop Mount Wyrmfang and resolve the fate of the Frost Wyrm.
stage_confront_vyr.objective: Confront Vyr the Ancient Frost Wyrm.

stage_completed.description: The northern holds are delivered from the draconic menace. You are hailed as the High Champion of Valenfrost.
stage_completed.objective: Return to Jarl Sigurd in triumph.

quests.title: Trial of the Frozen Shield
quests.description: Prove your martial worth to the Iron Covenant by putting an end to the frost troll terrorizing the deep shafts of Grimstone Mine.

stage_slay_troll.description: Slay the Mountain Frost Troll lurking in Infested Shaft Nine beneath Grimstone.

stage_report_karl.description: Present the troll thickhide to Veteran Karl in the Valenfrost Barracks.
stage_report_karl.objective: Report back to Karl the Iron-Ribbed.

stage_completed.description: Inducted as a sworn Shield-Brother of the Iron Covenant.

quests.title: The Ledger in the Mist
quests.description: Valeria of the Whispering Cabal needs her stolen smuggling ledger recovered from Marauder Captain Malik in the Drowned Fort.

stage_infiltrate_redoubt.description: Infiltrate the Drowned Fort Redoubt in Mistglen and reclaim the cipher ledger.

stage_return_valeria.description: Deliver the recovered ledger to Valeria in the Sunken Cistern Guildhall.

stage_completed.description: Welcomed into the inner circle of the Whispering Cabal with fencing privileges.

quests.title: Secrets of the Rime Spire
quests.description: Archmage Kallan charges you with solving the riddle of the ancient Rime Pillar and cataloguing the celestial Star-Key in the archives.

stage_solve_pillar.description: Decipher the Rime Pillar of Frostmere to obtain the Silver Key of the Winter Spire.

stage_consult_archives.description: Unlock the inner Arcanum Vault and study the ancient star manuscripts with Librarian Freya.

stage_completed.description: Granted the title of Winter Arcanist and gifted the Star-Key of the Glacial Spire.

quests.title: The Slumber of Skallagrim
quests.description: Draugr have been raiding outlying farms from the Weeping Barrow Stones. Break into the crypt and put Chieftain Skallagrim to rest.

stage_unlock_crypt.description: Acquire the Ancient Runic Barrow Key and unseal the crypt of Chieftain Skallagrim.

stage_defeat_skallagrim.description: Descend into the barrow depths and defeat Chieftain Skallagrim the Undying.

stage_completed.description: The ancestral curse is broken and the barrow dead return to peaceful slumber.

quests.title: The Silver Kin's Legacy
quests.description: Overseer Thrain lost the iron key to the ancestral silver vault during the troll breach in Shaft Nine. Find it and unlock the clan vault.

stage_find_vault_key.description: Search Infested Shaft Nine for the Overseer's dropped iron key.
stage_find_vault_key.objective: Find the Iron Key of Grimstone Vault.

stage_open_vault.description: Use the key to unlock the Grimstone Deep Clan Vault.

stage_completed.description: The ancestral vault is restored to Clan Silver-Kin.
